name: linger-image-gen
description: Generate and edit images with GPT-Image-2.5 Flare, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, and GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst through a configurable API. The same package also installs as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.

interface.longDescription: Generate, edit, and batch-create images using GPT-Image-2.5 Flare, GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst, or GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst. Configure your API endpoint, API key, enabled models, and default model with the npx installer.
defaultPrompt: Use Linger Image Gen to create a product photo.
Use Linger Image Gen to edit this image.
Use Sunburst to create a transparent PNG.
